ideas.name: potE1 after a mature side (30+ bars)
ideas.why: easing after a trend has run 30 bars is exhaustion of a mature move; easing in a young trend is a pause

ideas.name: potM1 after a mature side (30+ bars)
ideas.why: the same for the MACD row

ideas.name: potM1 in a young side (under 8 bars)
ideas.why: easing right after a cross is the new trend's first pullback, not a turn (expected to hurt)

ideas.name: potM1 repeated within 10 bars
ideas.why: a second easing soon after the first cleared is momentum failing to rebuild

ideas.name: potM1 with a deep histogram fall
ideas.why: a histogram already 40% down from its 10-bar peak is a real loss of momentum, not a one-bar wobble

ideas.name: flip1 ending a long side (40+ bars)
ideas.why: a flip that ends a side held 40 bars is a real trend change; flips after short sides are chop

ideas.name: any warning in the afternoon
ideas.why: afternoon sessions mean-revert more than mornings (lower participation), so called turns come true
